note: Probability that the borrower resolves the problem within 30 days after the action. Prior = base + lift; weight = 20 pseudo-observations so real pilot outcomes quickly dominate.

sms.source: Cadena & Schoar 2011, NBER w17020: RCT, Uganda, 1,121 SME borrowers; SMS reminder +7-9% on-time payment

personal_sms.source: Karlan, Morten & Zinman: RCT, Philippines; reminders worked only with the known loan officer's name (size: ASSUMPTION)

call.source: Laudenbach & Siegel 2025, Journal of Finance: RCT, personal calls raise repayment and cut re-default (size: ASSUMPTION)

restructure_offer.source: ASSUMPTION; evidence on flexible schedules is mixed (Field & Pande) -> measured in the pilot

personal_sms.title: SMS signed by the borrower's own officer

guarantor_call.title: Call the guarantor named in the contract

cost_source: ASSUMPTION: officer time ~800 UZS/min (8M UZS salary / 21 days / 8 h); SMS ~100 UZS; visit includes ~30k transport
excluded: Calling relatives or acquaintances who are not parties to the contract: disclosure of bank secrecy and personal data (Law on Bank Secrecy, 2003; Law on Personal Data, 2019).
